dialogues.speaker: Ziyad
dialogues.text: Pah! Grown-ups are such a pain. All they know is punishing people... And it's not like their reasons are ever any different. I'm always too naughty for them.

dialogues.speaker: Ziyad
dialogues.text: They did wrong in the first place. I'm just standing up for what's right!

dialogues.speaker: Ziyad
dialogues.text: I mean, you tell me: would you be sad if your father made your mother cry?
